reviewer: OpenAI GPT-6; read-only reviewer separate from Codex Q02 implementer; previously authored Q02 task brief, not Q02 code

reviewScope.summary: Independent read-only assessment of the complete committed Q02-F-FEEDBACK first batch against Q01 baseline, authoring source, generated content, affected test contracts, and release requirements.
evidence: Reviewed GitHub commit e329d043a1c747df9b27870ad809c2cda75f746d against Q01 master a166c45fbf6c970562672a8e23fc54840d044d85; branch, one-commit ancestry and 12-file GitHub diff confirmed.

Inspected uploaded ZIP with SHA-256 D1BDDC244DD05E100DF15C30085F63EA9245E09FED2E6030BA3481FE0476A8F3; verified included file checksums and sampled Git blob identities against the remote committed SHA.
Compared full pre/post authoring pilot JSON trees: exactly eight feedback.correct string changes in S1-M02-L01-E01 and S1-M02-P01-E01/E02/E04/E05/E06/E07/E08, with no other pilot changes.

Checked each of the eight pedagogical explanations against its exercise code and expected result. The unchanged E03 already explains non-automatic update; MCQ and coding feedback remain outside this intentionally bounded first batch.

Compared full M01, M02 and index snapshots: M01 changes only sourceSha256; M02 changes eight feedback strings and sourceSha256; index changes eight corresponding exercise content hashes and source sha256/bytes only. All 291 exercise IDs remain stable.

Independently recomputed SHA-256 of the three generated Q02 content assets and the canonical pilot; they agree with the committed catalogue, hash-addressed filenames and exporter pin. Pilot: ffecd016023017f06a33234d72ca9eec2305fc5bd7d42594e329127664ccc790, 1478593 bytes.
Compared offline manifest, source ledger and evaluator vectors: only expected asset paths, source identity and two authored-unit string digests changed; evaluator vectors contain no semantic changes.

Reviewed changed test assertions: programvareutvikling.test.ts removes redundant hardcoded hash/bytes; separate programvareutviklingContent.test.ts retains an exact independent hash and byte assertion, and exporter retains its own explicit pilot pin.

The evidence ZIP omitted changed docs/CURRENT_STATE.md and contained a Windows-encoding-damaged optional patch; fetched actual CURRENT_STATE.md from GitHub at Q02 SHA and verified its eight-line Q02 insertion. No product-content difference was concealed.

Codex reports 111 focused Vitest cases, source export checks, format/lint/typecheck, build/bundle and one browser rendering probe passing; these commands were not independently rerun by this reviewer.

adversarialFindings.description: Eight improved feedback strings alter exercise content hashes and make existing old-hash submissions historical rather than current mastery evidence.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted established version-bound evidence contract. Answers, evaluator rules, IDs, lesson order, duration and progression mechanics are unchanged; no migration or extra XP is introduced.

adversarialFindings.description: One programme registration test no longer independently hardcodes the source hash and byte length.
adversarialFindings.resolution: A separate content test still pins both exact values and the exporter independently pins the exact source; the remaining registration assertion verifies catalogue/index binding. No material regression in overall detection.

adversarialFindings.description: Provided evidence ZIP omitted changed CURRENT_STATE.md and its optional textual patch had PowerShell character-encoding damage.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Fetched missing current-state file and actual commit diff directly from GitHub on e329d043; verified generated snapshots and three Git blob identities. This is a non-blocking evidence packaging issue.

adversarialFindings.description: F-04 remains incomplete outside the narrow M02 L01/P01 first batch.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted explicit batch boundary. Only the eight confirmed feedback responses are under review; other feedback families belong in later Q02 batches and are not represented as corrected.

retrospective.summary: Q02 first batch is technically bounded and pedagogically defensible. No P0/P1/P2 release blocker found in the exact reviewed payload. The independent hosted gate, master merge certification, production alias and HTTP smoke remain separate future checks.
